title: A Dispute Over a Platinum Ticket
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ran, Sonoko, Kogoro, Inspector Megure, Detective Sato) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Discrepancy vs. the old lower-fidelity case file: the old file claimed the killing was 'a push causing a fatal fall onto a table corner' -- this specific mechanism is never stated or shown in the transcript, which only shows a confrontation cutting to Masako's collapse ('M-Masako?'); the `kills` edge here notes the mechanism as unspecified rather than inventing detail the source doesn't support. The old file's culprit (Kaori Kosuda) and overall theft/apron-swap mechanics are otherwise confirmed correct by the transcript. Two distinct physical aprons are modeled as separate object nodes (o2, o11) since the whole clue hinges on telling them apart: Kosuda's own apron (which carried the stolen tickets and rode through the dye-tainted wash cycle before she pulled it back out) vs. Masako's own apron (substituted into the machine afterward, never exposed to the dye). case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Apron in the washing machine has a white care label; the apron Kosuda is carrying has a pink-dyed one -- proves the aprons were swapped after the crime.
Shift schedule shows only Kosuda was off the Sunday tickets went on sale, contradicting her claim her boyfriend's colleague supplied them.
Kirima's phone saves Masako as 'Masa-chan', and the shift schedule shows them sharing days off -- reveals their hidden relationship.
